root_cause_label: Wrong Output Artifact Format (npy instead of txt)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly solved the optimization but saved the result as 'solution.npy' (binary) instead of the required 'solution.txt' (text), and then compounded the failure by misreading prior-run terminal output to falsely conclude the still-running second execution had also succeeded.
t_err_evidence: In step 4, the agent writes solve.py with 'np.save("solution.npy", result.x)' rather than 'np.savetxt("solution.txt", result.x)'; the autograder expects solution.txt but the script always produces solution.npy.
t_commit_evidence: Once the script is written with np.save to solution.npy (step 4), every subsequent invocation (steps 5, 7, 10) also saves to solution.npy; no version of the script ever produces solution.txt, locking in the wrong-artifact failure from step 4 onward.
trigger_explanation: The task autograder expects 'solution.txt' (readable text via np.savetxt), but the agent chose np.save('solution.npy', ...) without verifying the expected output format. The agent never read any spec or checked what the grader looks for; it assumed binary numpy format was acceptable.
